recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, symmetrical composition featuring a central male figure in black tactical leather gear and sunglasses, set against a saturated red background containing a faint, large-scale ghostly face. The bottom third is anchored by heavy, metallic, wide-spaced typography framed by horizontal rules.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure scale vs. background ghostly face scale
Deep black leather textures vs. vibrant red atmospheric glow
Metallic, beveled text vs. soft-focus background elements
Symmetrical alignment of the subject and the typographic block
coreInvariants: Monochromatic red background with dark vignettes
Subject wearing black sunglasses reflecting light
Horizontal red lines framing the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered, waist-up, occupying the middle vertical axis. A secondary, larger face is faded into the background behind him.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy, metallic title text at the bottom third acts as the structural base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's sunglasses, moves down the vertical line of the jacket to the title, then expands outward to the background eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and atmospheric; negative space is filled with a red gradient and soft-focus facial features.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds; extreme value contrast between the black leather and the red glow.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with sharp, clean edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Beveled 3D effect on the main title

composition.relationshipToImage: Framed by two thin horizontal red lines

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, textured display face paired with a clean, small-scale functional sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory box in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide, cinematic feel of the era.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and technical look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cinematic portrait of a man in a black leather trench coat and sunglasses, centered. The background is a deep, glowing red with a faint, large-scale face looming in the shadows. Leave the bottom third clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, wide-spaced title in metallic beveled uppercase letters in the lower third, framed by two thin horizontal red lines. Add a small white subtitle at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the background primarily saturated red?
Is the main title metallic and ultra-wide?
Is there a secondary face visible in the background?
Are there horizontal lines framing the main text?

postGenerationChecks: Check for beveled edge quality on text
Ensure the red background doesn't wash out the subject's silhouette
Verify the horizontal rules are perfectly straight
Confirm the tracking on the main title is sufficiently wide
recipe.reuseFormula: Central figure in dark gear + Saturated red atmospheric background + Wide-spaced metallic display type = 90s Action Aesthetic.
